title: Equipment purchase financing
metaDescription: Buying machinery, vehicles, or other long-life assets usually starts with equipment-financing, SBA 504, and SBA 7(a) comparisons. Learn which routes commonly fit the purchase.
summary: The equipment-purchase use-case page compares the financing routes most often reviewed when the goal is purchasing or refinancing business equipment.

hero.title: Buying equipment? Start with the asset-specific routes first.
hero.lead: Equipment requests can sit somewhere between a pure asset-backed structure and a broader SBA project. This page compares the paths borrowers most often review before choosing which one deserves a deeper look.

quickAnswer.definition: usually begins with equipment-financing, SBA 504, and SBA 7(a) comparisons because the right route depends on the asset type, project scope, and whether the request includes only equipment or a broader fixed-asset plan.

whoItFits.heading: When equipment-purchase financing tends to fit
items: Buying machinery, vehicles, or other long-life business equipment
Replacing or upgrading equipment tied directly to business operations

whenItMayNotFit.heading: When this path may not fit as well
items: If the business primarily needs recurring operating cash rather than a specific asset, a working-capital route is usually the better first comparison.
If the equipment request is only one part of a wider property or expansion project, the broader project route may matter more than the single asset.

sectionDisclosureHtml: Fund44 is not a lender. Equipment-financing availability, collateral treatment, SBA eligibility, timelines, and final terms are determined by third-party lenders or finance companies and vary by provider and by business profile. This page is educational only.

commonQuestions.question: What financing routes are usually compared for an equipment purchase?
commonQuestions.answer: Borrowers often start with equipment financing, SBA 504, and SBA 7(a) because the best fit depends on whether the request is only for equipment or part of a broader fixed-asset project.

commonQuestions.question: Why compare SBA 504 with equipment financing?
commonQuestions.answer: Equipment financing is often focused on the equipment itself, while SBA 504 is a broader fixed-asset program used for qualifying major equipment and owner-occupied real estate projects.

commonQuestions.question: What documents usually matter for an equipment request?
commonQuestions.answer: Common examples include an equipment quote or invoice, business financial statements, bank statements, and business tax returns. Exact document requirements vary by lender and by the asset.

commonQuestions.question: Does Fund44 provide the equipment financing directly?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Fund44 does not provide equipment financing directly. Lenders or finance companies determine eligibility and final terms.
